main.description: A zap: a small public USDC payment from this repo's owner to another Tessera user, executed on the payment rail referenced by railRef. rkey is the idempotency key.

amountUsd.description: Amount in integer micro-USD (1 USDC = 1000000; atproto has no floats).

ref.description: Optional: the zapped content (post, score, photo...).

railRef.description: Rail-specific transaction reference for third-party verification.
